meta.siteDescription: Play free online games instantly in your browser. No downloads, no login. New games from indie developers every week on Brainstorming Games.

common.mockModeHint: Running on local demo data. Nothing leaves this browser.
common.errorBody: Please try again in a moment.
common.rateLimited: Slow down a little and try again.

shell.lowDataOn: Low-data mode is on: smaller images, no video previews
shell.lowDataTurnedOn: Low-data mode on. Smaller images, no video previews.
shell.greetingBody: Pick any game and it starts in your browser. No downloads, no login.

action.name: Action
action.intro: Fast reflexes, close calls and big finishes. Action games throw you straight into the moment: dodge, jump, fight and chase your best run. Every game here starts in your browser in seconds, on a phone or a PC.

adventure.name: Adventure
adventure.intro: Explore new worlds one step at a time. Adventure games mix story, discovery and light puzzles, so there is always something around the next corner. Play free, with nothing to install.

arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.intro: Easy to learn, hard to put down. Arcade games are built for quick sessions and high scores, perfect for a short break. Tap play and chase one more run.

puzzle.name: Puzzle
puzzle.intro: Give your brain a workout. From matching and merging to logic and physics, puzzle games reward a calm head and a clever idea. Play at your own pace, free in your browser.

racing-driving.name: Racing & Driving
racing-driving.intro: Start your engine. Race cars and bikes, drift through corners or just enjoy the drive. These racing and driving games run instantly, with no download.

shooting.name: Shooting
shooting.intro: Take aim and stay sharp. Shooting games test your accuracy and timing across targets, arenas and waves. All of them are suitable for ages 12 and up.

sports.name: Sports
sports.intro: Cricket, football, basketball and more. Sports games bring quick matches and friendly rivalry to your browser. Play a full game in minutes.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.intro: Think two moves ahead. Build, defend, plan and outsmart. Strategy games reward patience and a good plan more than fast fingers.

simulation.name: Simulation
simulation.intro: Run a shop, fly a plane or build a city. Simulation games let you try a role and see what happens when you make the calls.

clicker-idle.name: Clicker & Idle
clicker-idle.intro: Tap, upgrade, repeat. Clicker and idle games grow while you play and keep growing in the background, so every visit has a new upgrade waiting.

io.name: .io
io.intro: Drop into an arena with players from around the world. .io games are simple to start and competitive within seconds.

card-board.name: Card & Board
card-board.intro: Ludo, carrom, chess, solitaire and other table classics. Card and board games are the easiest way to play something familiar, alone or with a friend.

word-trivia.name: Word & Trivia
word-trivia.intro: Find the word, beat the quiz. Word and trivia games are quick, clever and great for learning something new.

2-player.name: 2-Player
2-player.intro: Better with a friend. These games let two people play on the same device or join each other online. Start a party and send the link.

made-in-india.name: Made in India
made-in-india.intro: Games built by studios and solo developers from India. Play something made close to home and support the people who made it.

footer.label: Footer
footer.tagline: Free games. Zero downloads. Play in one tap.

home.heroPublishTitle: Publish your game on Brainstorming Games
home.heroPublishBody: Upload an HTML5 or WebGL build, get real players in days, and keep 70% or more of the ad revenue. Every game starts with a fair Spark Launch.

quests.intro: Play across games to complete quests and earn Brain Points. Points level you up and unlock looks for your mascot. They are not money and cannot be bought.
